name: Therapy Visit
description: A personal recap of a visit with a psychologist, therapist, or counselor.

sections.title: Visit Overview
sections.instruction: Summarize why the visit happened and what the person and clinician discussed, as far as the recording states. Write as a personal recap rather than a clinician's record.

sections.title: What I Shared
sections.instruction: Capture experiences, feelings, concerns, changes, or questions the person explicitly described. Do not infer symptoms or add a diagnosis.

sections.title: What We Discussed
sections.instruction: Summarize the clinician's responses, explanations, suggestions, and any discussion of diagnoses, medication, or other care when those topics actually came up. Attribute statements clearly and do not turn a discussion into a new clinical recommendation.

sections.title: What Stood Out
sections.instruction: Capture takeaways or reflections the person expressed about the visit. If interpreting what mattered, make that interpretation clear and ground it in the conversation.

sections.title: Questions for Next Visit
sections.instruction: List questions the person raised or wanted to revisit later. Omit this section when none were stated.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: Include only follow-up actions, exercises, appointments, or care changes explicitly discussed or chosen during the visit. Preserve who proposed each step and any timing when stated; omit this section when none were discussed.
